direct_message: There is not one Census ZIP-level measure that fully captures housing instability. These are direct housing-affordability indicators.
No strong direct ZIP-level measure of nutritious-food access is currently connected. The values below are related context, not direct measures of healthy-food accessibility.
No direct ZIP-level measure of sidewalks, recreation access, safe streets, or nearby activity opportunities is currently connected.
There is no direct ZIP-level measure of overall diet quality in the data sources currently connected to Upstream Health.
Insulin resistance itself is not routinely measured as a ZIP-level population statistic. These are related metabolic proxies.
